acceptedAnswer.text:
How long does kitchen drywall installation typically take?
A full kitchen drywall project generally takes three to five days to complete from hanging to paint-ready finish. Hanging the gypsum panels typically takes one day, but taping, applying multiple coats of joint compound, and proper drying take another two to three days. In the semi-arid Denver metro climate, joint compound dries relatively fast, but cold winter weather can lengthen mud curing times between coats. Final sanding and dust cleanup wrap up the process before painting or tile backsplash prep can begin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing and finishing kitchen drywall usually takes 3 to 5 days, mainly due to drying and sanding times between multiple coats of joint compound.
